# Copilot instructions

Read AGENTS.md at the repository root first. It is the engineering standard
for every coding agent here: ground rules, task flow, code rules, testing,
security, git and Merge Requests, definition of done, report format.

Then: `make help` for the commands, `make check` before claiming
completion, and the Bearing skills installed for this harness. The git hooks
in .githooks/ enforce commit shape, formatting and the rule that a person,
not the agent, pushes.
